title: 2022 AMC 8 Problem 20
statement: The grid below is to be filled with integers in such a way that the sum of the numbers in each row and the sum of the numbers in each column are the same. Four numbers are missing. The number \(x\) in the lower left corner is larger than the other three missing numbers. What is the smallest possible value of \(x?\)

solutions.text:
Adding the numbers in the top row shows that every row and column must have sum \(12\).

In the first column, the missing number above \(x\) is \(14-x\). In the bottom row, the missing number to the right of \(x\) is \(4-x\). In the middle row, the remaining missing number is \(x-1\).

Since \(x\) is larger than the other missing numbers, we need \(x>14-x\), \(x>4-x\), and \(x> x-1\). The strongest condition is \(x>7\), so the smallest possible integer value is \(8\).

Thus, the correct answer is D.
hints: The completed row and column sums must match the top row
